_README: MARKER-ONLY. English only. Fetched lazily by the engine when a teacher/marker PDF is built. Never rendered on the student-facing page.

markingScheme.criterion: Quotes the results of at least two of their own culture runs that differ in a culture condition, giving the number of healthy plantlets (out of 10) for each.
markingScheme.accept: Any two genuine rows from the student's Investigation Record (Lab = Plants, Culture run N) with their healthy counts, e.g. 'full recipe gave 9/10 but without sterilising only 2/10'. Check the figures against the Record table.
markingScheme.insufficient: A general statement such as 'more grew when it was sterile' with no figures; or figures from only one run.

markingScheme.criterion: Explains sterilising: it kills microorganisms (bacteria/fungi/mould) on the explants, which would otherwise grow on the nutrient agar and contaminate, outcompete or kill the explants.
markingScheme.accept: 'Kills bacteria or fungi so they do not grow on the agar / infect the plants / compete for the nutrients'. 'Germs' or 'microbes' acceptable for microorganisms.
markingScheme.insufficient: 'To keep it clean' or 'to stop contamination' with no mention of microorganisms or of what the contamination does.

markingScheme.criterion: Explains BOTH agar additives: nutrients supply what the explant needs for growth (it cannot yet absorb or make enough itself), AND plant hormones stimulate cell division / the growth of roots and shoots.
markingScheme.accept: Nutrients 'for energy/growth' or naming sugar/minerals; hormones 'make roots and shoots form' / 'make the cells divide and develop'. Auxin or cytokinin named is fine but not required.
markingScheme.insufficient: Mentions only nutrients or only hormones; or says both 'help it grow' without distinguishing what each does.

markingScheme.criterion: Nucleus transfer step: a (diploid) nucleus is taken from a body cell of the transgenic ewe and placed into an egg cell that has had its own nucleus removed (an enucleated egg cell).
markingScheme.accept: 'Take a body cell / udder cell nucleus from the ewe and put it in an empty / enucleated egg cell from another sheep'. 'Diploid' not required.
markingScheme.insufficient: 'Put her DNA into an egg' without stating that the egg's own nucleus is removed; or using an egg/gamete nucleus from the transgenic ewe instead of a body-cell nucleus.

markingScheme.criterion: Development step: the cell is given an electric shock to stimulate it to divide (by mitosis) into an embryo, AND the embryo is implanted into the uterus of a surrogate mother.
markingScheme.accept: 'Shocked so it starts dividing, then put into a surrogate / another ewe's womb'.
markingScheme.insufficient: Only one of the two (shock without surrogate, or surrogate without what makes the cell divide).

markingScheme.criterion: Reason for cloning rather than breeding: the clones are genetically identical to the transgenic ewe so ALL of them carry the gene / make the human protein, whereas breeding (sexual reproduction) mixes genes from both parents so only some offspring inherit it.
markingScheme.accept: 'All the clones will have the gene, but with breeding only some / about half of the lambs would' or reference to genetic variation from sexual reproduction. Credit use of the student's own Pharming data (e.g. 8/8 cloned vs 4/8 bred).
markingScheme.insufficient: 'Cloning is faster' or 'clones are identical' with no link to every animal carrying the gene / producing the protein.

criteria.source: Auto-marked from the Knowledge Check (auto_marked_score). The teacher does not mark this row.
= the Explain question's 3-point marking scheme above, one-to-one. Do not award these marks a second time here.

levels.descriptor: None of the three Explain points achieved: no own results quoted, and neither sterilising nor the agar additives correctly explained.

Any ONE of the three Explain points achieved: (a) quotes healthy-plantlet results from two of their own runs, (b) explains that sterilising kills microorganisms that would grow on the agar and harm the explants, or (c) explains what both nutrients and hormones do.
Any TWO of those three Explain points achieved.

All THREE achieved: two of their own runs quoted with healthy-plantlet counts, sterilising explained (kills microorganisms that would contaminate/outcompete the explants), and both nutrients (for growth) and hormones (cell division, roots and shoots) explained.

criteria.source: = the Apply question's 3-point marking scheme above, one-to-one. Do not award these marks a second time here.

levels.descriptor: None of the three Apply points achieved.

Any ONE of the three Apply points achieved: (a) body-cell nucleus from the transgenic ewe placed into an enucleated egg cell, (b) electric shock to start division plus implantation in a surrogate (only if (a) is also achieved), or (c) all clones carry the gene/make the protein whereas breeding passes it to only some offspring.
Any TWO of those three Apply points achieved.
All THREE achieved: nucleus transfer into an enucleated egg cell, shock and surrogate, and the reason (identical clones all make the protein; sexual reproduction mixes genes so only some would).

criteria.source: Assessed holistically across the Explain and Apply answers together. Independent of, and never overlapping with, the content marks above.

levels.descriptor: Too unclear or incomplete for the reasoning to be followed reliably.
Main meaning understandable, but organisation, precision or scientific vocabulary has problems (e.g. 'DNA thing' for nucleus, steps out of order).

Clear and logical, in full sentences, using appropriate terms correctly (e.g. explant, sterile, nucleus, enucleated, mitosis, surrogate, genetically identical). Minor spelling or grammar slips that do not affect meaning are not penalised.

markingInstructions: Mark ONLY the two constructed responses (Explain and Apply). Use each question's point-by-point marking scheme: award each point independently unless it states a dependsOn, in which case award it only if the point it depends on was also awarded. The rubric rows 'Evidence and explanation' and 'Applying the science' restate those same points as 0-3 bands and equal the Explain and Apply marks one-to-one (see each row's source); never add them a second time. Communication (0-2) is the only holistic mark and is judged across both answers together. Copy the auto-marked Knowledge Check score into 'Knowledge & understanding' (max 8). Total = 8 + 3 + 3 + 2 = 16. Verify any figures the student quotes against the Investigation Record table (rows with Lab = Plants and Run = 'Culture run N' show the conditions in Setup and healthy plantlets out of 10 in Count). Accept scientifically valid alternative wording per each point's 'accept' field; do not penalise spelling unless meaning is unclear. Report: total, percentage, score by criterion, one strength, one correction, one next step, in under 80 words.
